message:
@Consultant Phishing campaign The Information Security Office has identified an ongoing email phishing campaign targeting the URI community. The phishing emails are designed to appear as legitimate internal communications and prompt recipients to click on a link that redirects to a spoofed Microsoft login page. 
Potential senders include compromised accounts from other higher education institutions and compromised uri.edu accounts.
Potential subject lines include: "Notice connected to your ID", "Limitations related to your ID", "Alert about your ID", and similar variations
Suggested response for callers 
Do not click the link
Report the message using ProofPoint Phish Alarm.
Do not fill out the form associated with the link in the message.
Do not engage with the sender or forward the message.
@Consultant Just a reminder that next week is the start of Summer schedule.  That means if you are graduating in the next 2 weeks you will only be on schedule until tomorrow at the latest.
